minimo-mcp — connect an agent client to Minimo Games

Usage:
  minimo-mcp config <client> [options]  configure a client to use the bridge
  minimo-mcp bridge [options]           run the bridge (clients start this)
  minimo-mcp login [options]            sign in ahead of time
  minimo-mcp logout                     forget the stored credentials

Clients:
  codex          writes ~/.codex/config.toml
  claude-code    writes ~/.claude.json, at user scope
  claude-desktop writes the Claude Desktop configuration
  cursor         writes ~/.cursor/mcp.json
  antigravity    writes ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json
  chatgpt        prints the values for its custom MCP dialog

Options:
  --use-npx              force the `npx minimo-mcp bridge` form (automatic when installed)
  --client-id <id>       OAuth client (default cOjO699wl8dBRhQvWDAhsmf3x1ilYpH2)
  --callback-port <n>    loopback port for the sign-in (default 8765)
  --server <url>         MCP server URL (default https://minimo.games/mcp)
  --name <name>          name of the server entry (default minimo-games)
  --path <file>          configuration file to write, instead of the client's default
  --print                print the configuration without writing anything
  --dry-run              report what would change without writing anything
  -h, --help             show this help
  -v, --version          show the version

The client talks to a local bridge, and the bridge is the OAuth client: it signs
you in, keeps the credentials in ~/.minimo-mcp/credentials.json, and refreshes
them. No token is ever pasted into a client, a configuration file, or a
conversation.
